description: This is a PHP source code file defining the 'Shipping' class within the OpenCart extension system. The class extends a system engine model and provides a method to calculate shipping totals, incorporating shipping costs and taxes, and updating the totals and taxes arrays accordingly.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Represents the shipping total calculation extension within the OpenCart system, responsible for adding shipping costs and associated taxes to the totals.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the shipping total to the overall cart totals, applying taxes if applicable.
